name: cancel written while a final is already in flight
description: The race the client cannot avoid: the user presses Esc at the same moment the server commits an utterance. Ordering on the pipe cannot help, because the final was written before the cancel was read. Rule: once the client has written cancel for a session it discards every subsequent partial and final for that session, and waits for stopped. The server must still send stopped so the teardown is acknowledged rather than timed out.
